Dana: Scan found `vault:enc:` blobs inside builder cache layer pushed to gcr.io/redwood-staging/builder-cache:nightly-2026-05-03.
Wei: Which pipeline produced that image?
Dana: Nightly builder. Artifact path in image layer: /build/output/logs/step-42.out.tar.gz containing base64 `vault:enc:ZHFz...`.
Marco: That could be sensitive. Immediate actions: quarantine image (untag + deny), snapshot for forensics, and remove any external pull bindings.
Dana: Agreed. I'll untag and set Artifact Registry to deny all pulls except internal SAs.
Wei: Check KMS audit for decrypt calls against `projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/wrap/cryptoKeys/builder-wrap`. Running query now -> shows 17 decrypt attempts in last 72h, 2 from `serviceAccount:thirdparty-runner@ext-partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
Marco: That partner SA shouldn't have decrypt rights. I'll prepare an IAM delta to remove decrypt role and restrict to `serviceAccount:vault-proxy@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` + `group:secops@redwood`.
SecBot: Created incident INC-2026-3001 (sev=medium). Playbook link: docs/security/playbooks/container-creds-leak.md. Assign Dana (quarantine), Marco (IAM/KMS), Wei (audit + rewrap).
Wei: Rewrap plan: create new KMS key wrap-nightly-rot, update Vault transit config to stage switchover, then call Vault transit/rewrap for stored ciphertexts. Will test on a small sample first. Note: Vault rewrap is server-side; plaintext is not returned.
Marco: IAM change applied to remove external runner decrypt binding. :lock: Also added a logging sink to secops_bq.kms_decrypts with filter on Decrypt calls.
Dana: Added pre-publish scanner to build pipeline to grep for `vault:(enc|v[0-9]+):` and fail builds. Putting patch in infra repo.
Wei: Pilot rewrap succeeded, no plaintext exposed. Scheduling full rewrap during a 3h maintenance window. Will also rotate any staging DB creds that had short TTLs as a precaution.
Marco: After rewrap, revoke old key decrypt permissions and rotate short-lived creds. Also set alert: >25 decrypt failures from single principal in 1h -> page.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-3001 updated: status=containment, severity=medium. Logs and actions recorded.
Dana: Thanks team. Upload rewrap logs & the IAM PR link to the incident doc when done.
